title: Explainable models predict cancer drug sensitivity and nominate drugs
summary: Explainable machine learning models trained on cell line transcriptomics predicted drug sensitivity, with large language models used to expand drug mechanism-of-action descriptions and match them to pathways. Using only LLM-curated genes improved predictive accuracy, best-scoring drugs for TCGA patients matched those prescribed for their cancer type, and predicted drugs were experimentally validated in pancreatic cancer and glioblastoma patient samples. The number of validated drugs and samples is not given in the abstract. Preprint of 2024-03-30.
